decisions.reason: It remained on the website across two years and fits the firm’s core spraying know-how, so a medium-sized innovative machinery firm with some slack would likely keep this niche extension while its market performance becomes clearer.

Its own product page in both years and evidence of field testing suggest performance is at least promising relative to aspirations, and its close fit with established injection equipment lowers the case for withdrawal.

Because it builds on proven air-motor technology and extends the existing pump portfolio, management would likely view it as a low-risk adjacent product worth retaining despite limited public performance signals.

A dedicated page in both years and its relevance to monitored, more interoperable customer operations make it strategically valuable, so the firm is unlikely to reallocate resources away from it soon.

As the newest launch with only a brief 2024 mention it has the most uncertainty, but its close relation to the established spraying business and the firm’s innovation capacity make continued market presence more likely than an early drop.
